description: Source code for handling interrupts and triggers for the STTS751 temperature sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: stts751_enable_int
methods.description: Enables or disables the interrupt pin for the STTS751 sensor.

methods.name: stts751_trigger_set
methods.description: Sets up a trigger for the sensor, linking external trigger to data ready event.

methods.name: stts751_handle_interrupt
methods.description: Handles the interrupt event, reads status, and calls the registered handler if needed.

methods.name: stts751_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback function invoked on interrupt.

methods.name: stts751_thread
methods.description: Thread function for handling interrupts if configured with own thread.

methods.name: stts751_work_cb
methods.description: Work callback for handling interrupts if configured with global thread.

methods.name: stts751_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes GPIO and interrupt handling for the sensor.
